comparison.objective: Slide a skid beneath a slightly raised machine; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-133 tests constrained horizontal placement under clearance; candidate tests tool insertion, fine rotation, counterholding, and repeated impact commissioning.
comparison.success_condition: PR-133 only states the 30 mm lift limit and skid placement; detailed scoring thresholds are absent and no spec versions exist. Candidate measures stopping dynamics and setting retention.
comparison.reason: The available objective and manipulation family are clearly unrelated despite sparse PR-133 rubric detail.
